title: GET /api/auth/github — initiate GitHub OAuth login flow
description: Set up GitHub OAuth login using Passport.js GitHub strategy. This is for login/registration only — GitHub repo integration is separate (TASK-56).
acceptanceCriteria: Creates or finds user by github_id or email
On success: issues tokens, redirects to FRONTEND_URL/auth/callback?token=ACCESS_TOKEN

steps.details: Add GitHubStrategy to config/passport.ts with clientID (GITHUB_CLIENT_ID), clientSecret (GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET), callbackURL ('/api/auth/github/callback'), scope: ['user:email']. In verify: find user by github_id OR email. Create if not found. Note: GitHub may not return email if user has it private — handle gracefully (use github_id as primary key for lookup).
GET /github → passport.authenticate('github', { scope: ['user:email'], session: false }). GET /github/callback → authenticate, then issue tokens and redirect same as Google.
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/api/auth/github, authorize the app, verify redirect with token. Verify user in DB has github_id set.

technicalNotes: GitHub login and GitHub repo integration use DIFFERENT OAuth apps with different scopes
Login OAuth app only needs 'user:email' scope
Repo integration OAuth app needs 'repo' or 'public_repo' scope — handled in TASK-56
